title: CLASSIC-STUN: dissect the entire packet on first-pass
description:
Request-response tracking of STUN messages encapsulated in CLASSIC-STUN
packets (via DATA attribute) doesn't work right now.

The reason for this is that req-resp tracking is usually performed on
first-pass, but CLASSIC-STUN attributes are not dissected on first-pass
(on wireshark, at least). So the encapsulated STUN messages are never
elaborated on first pass, either.

There is some boilerplate since I needed to re-indent the code, but the patch basically only remove an if branch.

You can test this patch with [classicstun_firstpass.pcapng](/uploads/b794f1fea6890eeb0c13f0651f9f52fa/classicstun_firstpass.pcapng): without this change, the pairs 3-5 and 4-6 are not properly detected

notes.body: While I am pretty confident that this change fixes the reported issue, I am not so sure I got the "first-pass"/"tree" stuff right...
